evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix tooltip for view options button in resource details panel
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix tooltip for view options button in resource details panel ## Description Regression in Aspire 13.1: hovering over the options button in the resource details panel displays "ActionsButtonText" instead of "View options". **Root cause:** `ResourceDetails.razor` referenced the wrong localized resource string for the tooltip. **Change:** Updated line 23 to use `Resources.ResourcesChangeViewOptions` instead of `ControlsStrings.ActionsButtonText`. ```diff - Title="@Loc[nameof(ControlsStrings.ActionsButtonText)]" + Title="@Loc[nameof(Resources.ResourcesChangeViewOptions)]" ``` ## Checklist - Is this feature complete? - [x] Yes. Ready to ship. - [ ] No. Follow-up changes expected. - Are you including unit tests for the changes and scenario tests if relevant? - [ ] Yes - [x] No - Did you add public API? - [ ] Yes - [x] No - Does the change make any security assumptions or guarantees? - [ ] Yes - [x] No - Does the change require an update in our Aspire docs? - [ ] Yes - [x] No
